limitations: Reuses the existing synthetic corpus; this is operator-family holdout, not independent program holdout.
Mutation generation, coverage-based selection and branch coverage all have prior work.
Exact means optimal for the finite recorded matrix and lexicographic objective only.
Planning costs are paid before suite selection; replay compression is not end-to-end speedup.
Unseen evaluation fault family is excluded from shadow generation and is evaluated after selection.
Boundary anchors preserve generator center proposals, not solver-proven path reachability.
Shared AST/IR numeric primitives and bounded execution remain limitations.
